description.value:
The Academy's basic Clone Technique. You produce a single illusory duplicate of yourself in your space or an adjacent square. The clone has 1 HP, your AC, and matches your appearance exactly; it cannot attack or interact with objects. The first attack or area effect that targets the clone destroys it harmlessly.

While the clone exists, the first Strike against you each round must succeed at a flat DC 11 check or be redirected to the clone (which is then destroyed). The clone lasts up to 1 minute or until destroyed.

Heightened (3rd) You create two clones instead of one; the redirect flat-DC drops to DC 6.

Heightened (5th) You create three clones; the redirect flat-DC drops to DC 4.
